signals.name: Stanley Druckenmiller
signals.latest_title: Stan Druckenmiller Says He's "Taking a Break" From Stocks
signals.summary: At the TomorrowX conference in Austin (about Nov 17), he said he is pulling back from stocks and that Duquesne is roughly flat equities and short copper. He said he has rarely had less clarity on the next 12 months. This comes from secondary reports, and they disagree on some details.
signals.connection: His caution fits today's AI-led selloff and the Dow's move past 50,000. It also fits the whipsaw in chip stocks.

signals.name: Michael Burry
signals.summary: In a Nov 10 Substack post, he said Nvidia could be a short-term trade after its drop but that its edge will shrink within five years. Other coverage reports he holds Nvidia puts. It also reports his claims that customers are paying more slowly and that depreciation accounting inflates industry earnings. These come from secondary reports.
signals.connection: This bears directly on the Nvidia and Jensen Huang CEO turmoil and the chip-stock whipsaw. It also bears on the AI-trade selloff.

signals.name: Ben Thompson
signals.summary: He argues that Jensen Huang has been granted an exception from managerial oversight and that, in the age of AI, he won't be the last. A separate piece on Amazon earnings says Amazon is willing to give up margin to serve the frontier, and it also covers the chip question and agents.
signals.connection: The first piece speaks directly to Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO. The Amazon piece ties to custom chips and AI compute economics.

signals.name: Packy McCormick
signals.summary: A roundup of optimistic tech and science news. It covers SpaceX reusability, a leukemia vaccine and a pancreatic pill, Tesla Powercore, and Earth AI's gold discovery.
signals.connection: It offers a counterweight to the AI-selloff mood. It also touches on energy and applied tech.

signals.name: Lenny Rachitsky
signals.latest_title: OpenClaw for executives: Automate every 1% annoyance | Ankit Maheshwari (Innovaccer)
signals.summary: Innovaccer CTO Ankit Maheshwari shows the OpenClaw agent assistant he runs on a Mac Mini. A separate interview covers what makes a great PM in the AI era, with juniors as a secret weapon.
signals.connection: Both pieces are about agents and AI's effect on work. That ties to the labor and workforce theme.
